mechanism: Avoid repeated parent traversal when revisiting leaves.

change: Add 64 direct-mapped leaf references with full origin checks and existing native invalidation callbacks.

claim: Separating secondary lookup from the common leaf-hit path makes the native cache improve coherent reads.
mechanism: E1 assembly showed a leaf-index lambda call in the cache variant's read loop. A small forced-inline entry point and non-inlined miss helper keep that call off last-leaf hits.

change: Preserve the original native membership predicate and tree fallback; move secondary lookup into an explicit miss helper.
